scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it recently and wanted to see where things stand.
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, loan ID LOAN-00249, has been originated.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that update. Can you tell me if my application was approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application resulted in loan origination.

dialogue.user: That's good news! So, it was approved then? What are the specifics of the loan, like the interest rate and total costs?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 9.590%, and the total loan costs were $99.00.

dialogue.user: Okay, 9.590% interest. And are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: That's a relief to hear. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record indicates that your loan was not sold to another institution; the purchaser type is not applicable.

dialogue.user: I see. So, just to confirm, my loan was approved, the interest rate is 9.590%, the total costs were $99.00, and it hasn't been sold. Is that all correct?
dialogue.agent: Yes, that is correct. Your loan was originated with an interest rate of 9.590% and total loan costs of $99.00, and it has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: <Satisfied> I'm satisfied with this interaction. You were able to clearly answer my questions about the status and key details of my loan application, and I appreciate you confirming the information for me.
